ZEC.summary: The NU7 upgrade is set for about Nov 5 (block 3,543,405): 25-second blocks and a mechanism that takes 60% of block fees out of circulation until 2031, and ZEC rallied when the height was finalized. No vesting unlocks (proof-of-work issuance only). Supports the long, with some risk of an upgrade delay.

news.title: Zcash devs finalize NU7 mainnet activation height 3,543,405, targeting around Nov 5; ZEC up about 12%
Privacy coins ZEC and XMR outperform Bitcoin on the week ahead of NU7, which cuts block time to 25s and sets aside 60% of fees

MORPHO.summary: Integrations keep coming and support the long: Robinhood stock tokens as collateral and Ledger wallet loans built on Morpho, plus Morpho driving most recent DeFi stablecoin growth. The risk is about 973K MORPHO stolen from institution-linked wallets that could be sold. No unlocks in the next 14 days.

news.title: Robinhood stock tokens go live as collateral for USDG loans on Morpho; Robinhood Chain TVL reaches $1.14B
Ledger Wallet launches crypto-backed stablecoin loans running on Morpho markets
About 973K MORPHO stolen from two institution-linked addresses and routed to Tornado Cash; no protocol bug confirmed

DOT.summary: Negative headlines support the short: the Fearless Wallet seed-phrase leak, a JAM migration with no mainnet date, and relay-chain fees reported as far above rivals. No vesting unlocks; issuance runs at about 55M DOT a year under the hard cap.

news.title: Fearless Wallet extension found leaking recovery phrases; users told to move funds after about 17K DOT taken
Polkadot publishes a JAM migration roadmap with no mainnet date
Relay chain nearly emptied after the Asset Hub migration; a referendum to rename to JAM fails

WCT.summary: Nothing material this week. Monthly unlocks fall on the 15th; the next (Nov 15) is outside the 14-day window.

LIT.summary: News supports the long: Lighter plans to apply for CFTC licenses in November, Delphi called it the clearest second bet after Hyperliquid, and it added options and weETH collateral. No unlocks in the window; the big team/investor cliff (50% of supply) is Dec 27, which matters if the trade is still open then.

news.title: Lighter founder says it will apply for US CFTC derivatives licenses in November; LIT up about 23% on the week
Lighter adds ether.fi's weETH as perp collateral after launching 15-minute BTC/ETH up/down options

ANIME.summary: No material news this week. Tokenomist shows no unlocks in the next 14 days (the next listed, to Community Cultivation, is Nov 23, outside the window).

BERA.summary: No material news this week. DefiLlama lists no BERA unlocks scheduled after Oct 25; only ongoing validator and reward-vault emissions, which add a little supply.
